# Numeraise - Full Financial Calculation Specification & Formulas

> Comprehensive mathematical documentation for Numeraise financial calculators (https://numeraise.com).

## 1. Systematic Investment Plan (SIP)
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/sip-calculator`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/sip-calculator`
- **Mathematical Formula**:
  $$FV = P \times \frac{(1 + r)^n - 1}{r} \times (1 + r)$$
  Where:
  - $P$ = Periodic investment amount (e.g., Monthly SIP)
  - $r$ = Monthly periodic rate of return $(Annual Return / 12 / 100)$
  - $n$ = Total number of monthly installments $(Years \times 12)$
  - $FV$ = Future Maturity Value

## 2. Loan Equated Monthly Installment (EMI)
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/emi-calculator`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/emi-calculator`
- **Mathematical Formula**:
  $$EMI = \frac{P \times r \times (1 + r)^n}{(1 + r)^n - 1}$$
  Where:
  - $P$ = Principal loan amount
  - $r$ = Monthly interest rate $(Annual Rate / 12 / 100)$
  - $n$ = Loan tenure in months $(Years \times 12)$
  - Total Interest Payable $= (EMI \times n) - P$

## 3. Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/cagr-calculator`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/cagr-calculator`
- **Mathematical Formula**:
  $$CAGR = \left(\frac{FV}{PV}\right)^{\frac{1}{t}} - 1$$
  Where:
  - $PV$ = Initial present value / investment amount
  - $FV$ = Final maturity / portfolio value
  - $t$ = Investment time horizon in years

## 4. Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP)
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/swp-calculator`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/swp-calculator`
- **Monthly Recurrence**:
  $$Balance_{t} = Balance_{t-1} \times (1 + r) - W$$
  Where:
  - $W$ = Monthly withdrawal amount
  - $r$ = Monthly periodic return $(Annual Return / 12 / 100)$

## 5. Step-Up SIP (Annual Increment)
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/step-up-sip`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/step-up-sip`
- **Mechanics**:
  The monthly installment increases annually by a step-up rate $s$:
  $$P_{year = k} = P_1 \times (1 + s)^{k-1}$$

## 6. Financial Independence, Retire Early (FIRE)
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/fire-calculator`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/fire-calculator`
- **The 4% Trinity Rule**:
  $$Target Corpus = \frac{Annual Expenses}{Withdrawal Rate} = Annual Expenses \times 25$$

## 7. US 401(k) Retirement with Employer Match
- **Route**: `https://numeraise.com/calculators/401k-calculator`
- **Embed URL**: `https://numeraise.com/embed/401k-calculator`
- **Annual Contribution**:
  $$Annual Total = (Salary \times Employee\%) + \min(Salary \times Match\%, Salary \times MatchCap\%)$$

---
All calculations execute 100% client-side via JavaScript with multi-currency formatting across USD, INR, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD, SGD, and AED.
